# Bull Trend Tracker

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. Trend following accepts many small losses and late exits by design; it is a discipline, not a forecast. Curated by Skill Harbor: a trend-following workflow from the Weaxs stock-analysis-plugin, built on the simple idea of entering only after a trend is confirmed and leaving when it weakens. It gathers 120 days of candles and indicators, then checks the bull case item by item (averages stacked in order, MA5 above MA10 above MA20 above MA60, MACD running above zero, price riding a rising channel, pullbacks holding above prior lows), and the mirror-image bear case. It then places the trend in one of four stages, launch, acceleration, maturity, or decay, each with its own posture from building a position to reducing to exiting, for example when price breaks the MA20 or the trendline. The report includes a trend-strength score from 1 to 10 (slope and alignment of the averages standing in for ADX), the key support and resistance levels, a note on whether the latest pullback stayed inside the healthy 38.2 to 50 percent retracement band, and a suggested stop level. From the Weaxs/stock-analysis-plugin repository (MIT). Honest caveats: the source SKILL.md is written in Chinese; the method deliberately does not try to pick tops or bottoms, so it will always look slow at turning points; stage labels are judgment calls built from the listed features, not measurements. Skill Harbor never reviews...
